brief:
A memorial installation in Berlin has recreated the vehicle in which six-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab was killed, according to Al Jazeera English. The display features a car riddled with bullet holes, positioned as a public reminder of her death and the circumstances surrounding it. The exhibition has drawn visitors seeking to pay respects and learn details of her case.

The installation represents efforts by activists and memorial organizers to preserve awareness of civilian casualties amid the ongoing Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Such displays have become part of broader advocacy initiatives across Europe documenting and commemorating Palestinian deaths. The Berlin memorial joins similar efforts in other cities to maintain public attention on victims of the conflict.
dek: A memorial display in Berlin has recreated the scene of the killing of six-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab.
title: Berlin displays bullet-riddled car honoring slain Palestinian girl
